title: AffirmativeAI: Towards LGBTQ+ Friendly Audit Frameworks for Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: The paper proposes an audit framework (AffirmativeAI) that prompts LLMs with scenarios specific to LGBTQ+ experiences (e.g., coming out, discrimination) and evaluates the responses based on affirmative therapy principles (Affirmative Attitude, Accurate Knowledge, Appropriate Action) using expert therapist review and quantitative comparison against therapist responses.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
